newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Qats Co Q3 net increases.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Qats Co Q3 net increases.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q3 1996 net income after $133.6 million pretax or $0.59 a share gain on sale of frozen foods business and $23.0 million in pretax restructuring charges or $0.14 a share. Q3 1996 operating income $0.53 a share.
Q3 1996 net income before preferred dividends of $900,000 vs $1.0 million a year ago.
Q3 1995 sales included $72.3 million in sales from divested business.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Nine-month 1996 results include $0.60 a share in gains on divestitures and $0.14 a share in restructuring charges. Nine-month 1995 include pretax gains on divestitures of $5.20 a share, and charges for restructuring and trademark infringement lawsuit totaling $0.40 a share. Excluding items, nine-month 1996 net income $1.22 vs $0.95.
Nine-month 1996 sales included $85.6 million in sales from divested businesses. Nine-month 1995 sales included $706.6 million in sales from divested busienss.
Nine-month 1996 net income before $2.9 million in preferred dividends vs $3.0 million.
